reuse.why: Fintegra reuses linking, downloading and bank lookup, but the guard duplicates unlink cleanup and bypasses the new assertAccountNotLinked helper.

duplication.why: Provider handlers share the guard, but local unlink cleanup and duplicate-link rejection each have two definitions.

placement.why: Changes follow the existing accounts, sync and model layers, although shared link policy is split between app.ts and link.ts.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the requested linking rules, replacement option and Fintegra integration.

maintainability.why: The shared guard is useful, but provider-specific functions now serve other providers and Fintegra requires a corrective database write after SimpleFin persistence.

bypasses_abstraction.where: app.ts: withBankAccountGuard independently implements rejection instead of using assertAccountNotLinked and copies unlinkAccount's local cleanup rather than sharing that operation.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated rejection and unlink cleanup remain directly recognizable; Fintegra calls existing implementations rather than reshaping copies.

abstraction_drift.where: linkSimpleFinAccount gains a provider parameter and a Fintegra-only corrective-write branch; downloadAkahuTransactions gains server and provider parameters; withBankAccountGuard bypasses assertAccountNotLinked.
